relations.description: Emergency registration failure handling procedure includes steps from mobility and periodic registration update procedure
Emergency registration failure handling requires UE to be in same selected PLMN for certain actions
When UE is in same PLMN, it establishes the action to inform upper layers of procedure failure
When UE is in same PLMN, it establishes the action to perform local de-registration
Local de-registration action includes attempting initial registration for emergency services
Abnormal case b failure condition establishes the action to inform upper layers of network access failure
Abnormal cases c or d failure condition establishes the action to inform upper layers of procedure failure
Abnormal cases c or d failure condition establishes the action to perform local de-registration
